> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **231** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **166** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **166**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **107** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **4** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0f7389cca1edb33f76e9950cf6648c8197933c67` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `4b576805e8eb2950ce6d2fe55c259cdcb76eadcd` — the merge of head `6fcbd688e5e98ec867c4030884b408aaa7bd075c` into base `0f7389cca1edb33f76e9950cf6648c8197933c67`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 4b576805e8eb2950ce6d2fe55c259cdcb76eadcd && git checkout 4b576805e8eb2950ce6d2fe55c259cdcb76eadcd
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 0f7389cca1edb33f76e9950cf6648c8197933c67 6fcbd688e5e98ec867c4030884b408aaa7bd075c && git checkout -B drift-repro 0f7389cca1edb33f76e9950cf6648c8197933c67 && git merge --no-ff 6fcbd688e5e98ec867c4030884b408aaa7bd075c

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0f7389cca1edb33f76e9950cf6648c8197933c67
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 0f7389cca1edb33f76e9950cf6648c8197933c67` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `dcc2177de15988c0d264c74939cea0488295e719`
Local-runs: none
Scope: `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts`, `packages/lint/src/object-graph.ts`, `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.ts`, `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts`, `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.test.ts`, `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.runtime-surface.test.ts` + read in the cited code, not reviewed: `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` (`ObjectExtensionSchema`, `FieldDisplayPatchSchema`), `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.zod.ts` (the `object_extension` registry row), `docs/adr/0090-permission-model-v2-concept-convergence.md` (D3), `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-authoring-gate.ts`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-extension-redeclared-owner-field.ts`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-extension-field-suffix.ts`, `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` (the `extend` arm and `mergeObjectDefinitions`), `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/manifest.ts`. Prose faces not reviewed: `.changeset/31998-role-word-object-extensions.md`, `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`.

Inputs read: card #31998 body and all 6 comments (triage 6754733467, claim 6754956777, amendments 6755007508 / 6755042440 / 6756008506, dev report 6756642483); PR #32034 body, its 8-file list and the net diff `origin/main...dcc2177d` (merge base `c9246279`; `main` has since moved to `60996d4a` with no change to any file of this diff or to `object.zod.ts`); the check-runs on the head.

### ① Derived judgments

Check-runs on `dcc2177d` at the time of this read: 64 runs, 20 success, 10 skipped, 34 in progress, 0 failed. Concluded green: Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Spec property liveness, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Type Check · source gates, Build Docs, Check Documentation Links, Dogfood Regression Gate. ⛔ Not yet concluded: Test Core 1-8/8, Build Core, Type Check · workspace / consumer gates / debt ledger, Lint · repo and tooling gates, Lint · CI, release and engine gates, Lint · scoped · slot lookup and corpus, and the UI families. Nothing was run locally to stand in for them. The judgments below are read off the tree; the verdict covers the contract, and a red conclusion on any pending family on this head is not covered by it.

Accept-set changes the diff implies, each read in the code:

1. **`validateSecurityRoleWord` refuses an `objectExtensions` entry's added field by name, else by label** (`flagRole`, path `ENTRY.fields.F.name` / `.label`). Right. The identifier-first, label-second order and both messages are the owner loop's own closure, unchanged in output: the refactor moves the label push into `flagRoleLabel` with the same severity, rule id, message and hint, and the label path is still derived by the same `replace`.
2. **It refuses the entry's `label` (kind `object`) and each `fieldPatches.FIELD.label` (kind `field`).** Right, and it is what claim amendment 2 ruling 2 ordered: `mergeObjectDefinitions` serves both as the object's and the field's label, which the owner loop judges as `obj.label` and `f.label`. Option labels, `pluralLabel`, `description`, `inlineHelpText` and `placeholder` stay unjudged, as on the owner.
3. **No `isSystemObject` exemption on the extension walk.** Right. ADR-0090 D3 names one exception, the better-auth boundary, and `isSystemObject` implements it on what the platform declares. First-party extensions on `sys_*` targets read at this head: `plugin-auth` `sys_sso_provider.oidc_client_secret` only; it does not carry the word.
4. **`object_extension` becomes a gated runtime write type** (`TYPE_TO_STACK_KEY` row + the rule's `runtimeTypes`). Right. `metadata-plugin.zod.ts` registers the type `allowRuntimeCreate: true`; `judgeRuntimeAuthoringRules` hands `evt.body` to the gate on an `active` write for every type; `buildRuntimeWriteSnapshotSet` builds a candidate of `objectExtensions: [item]` beside the four context collections and carries no `packages` key, so the fold reads the top-level list and the written item is `objectExtensions[0]`. The key is not a context key, so the baseline holds no extension and nothing cancels the written item's own finding. `isLocatedOnAnotherEntry` reads `objectExtensions[0]…` as positional at the written slot. No other rule declares the type, so the row turns on exactly one rule; a rule without `runtimeTypes` does not pick the type up.
5. **`VisibleObjectExtension` gains `label` and `fieldPatches`** (an exported interface of `@objectstack/lint`). Additive, right. The `kept` filter and the sort are untouched, so which entries survive the fold is unchanged for its three earlier readers. A non-record patch is dropped rather than thrown on.
6. **Unchanged, and checked:** the owner loop (objects, fields, actions, field groups), permissions, positions, apps, books; the draft carve-out (no rule gates a draft), the `package-author` channel and `migrate-stored` early returns.

No published schema, no `packages/spec` path and no governed path is in the diff.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/31998-role-word-object-extensions.md`: `@objectstack/lint` minor, a BREAKING banner, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, an `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker. It matches what the diff publishes: only `packages/lint/src/**` changes; the published change is a narrowed accept-set at the CLI and the `object_extension` publish door plus two additive interface keys; no schema key is added, removed or renamed, so there is no rewrite to prescribe. Check Changeset and PR-body guards concluded success on this head.

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — the PR body, the changeset and claim amendment 3 agree; the bare `no` of the claim and amendments 1-2 is superseded by amendment 3, as it says.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **`open_questions`: empty.** Nothing to answer.
- **`object-graph.ts` outside the claim's file surface** (dev flag, PR Acceptance notes). Answered: accepted by claim amendment 3, and the edit is what it says, two read-only keys with no change to the fold's survivors.
- **`Clause-②: no (narrowing)` instead of the claim's bare `no`** (dev flag). Answered: accepted by claim amendment 3.
- **`authoring-rules.ts` and the runtime-surface test** are inside the surface claim amendment 2 added.
- **`out_of_scope_findings`, carrier none: the runtime gate runs only this rule on `object_extension` writes.** Confirmed in the tree (`runtimeAuthoringRulesFor('object_extension')` is this one rule; the CLI judges an extension's fields through `objectsAsServed` under several others). Not this card's to close and no reason to hold this PR, but "noted, not filed" leaves it with no carrier: escalated to the seat to file as its own card.
- **Reviewer's own, outside the card (escalated, not a finding on this diff):** the rule reads no top-level `stack.actions`, while `ObjectExtensionSchema`'s `actions` guidance sends an extension author to a top-level action with `objectName: 'TARGET'`. Whether such an action's name or label carrying the word passes where `objects[].actions[]` refuses is unmeasured here; it is the same door-split shape and wants the same reading this card got.

### ④ Design judgment

**The narrowing makes the spec's own refusal real; it takes no declared capability away.** Read against `main`:

- ADR-0090 D3 bans the word "in identifiers, UI copy, and documentation, enforced by lint", with one exception it names. `ObjectExtensionSchema` declares the capability "add fields to, relabel, and patch the display of another package's object"; it declares nothing about this word. Every refused shape has a spelling of the same capability that passes (another field name, another label), so no capability the schema declares is undeliverable after the change. What is refused is exactly what the owner door already refuses on the same served object.
- The registry merges an extension's `fields` into the target's field map, its `label` over the target's, and applies `fieldPatches` labels on every read, so the three judged slots are the three that reach the same admin-facing surfaces the owner loop judges. `ObjectExtensionSchema` is strict and refuses `actions` and `fieldGroups` by name, so the two other owner-loop surfaces have no slot on an extension and nothing is left unwalked on the entry.
- Attempts to break it, each read in the code:
  - *Hide the word in an entry the fold drops.* The fold keeps one entry per package per target; the registry's `extend` arm does the same replacement, so the dropped entry's fields are never served. Pinned by the eighth CLI case.
  - *A target the stack does not declare.* The walk reads the fold, not `objectsAsServed`, so an entry is judged whatever its target; the `sys_user` case pins it.
  - *A `packages[]` artifact.* Read from each body, path `packages[j].manifest.objectExtensions[i]…`; pinned.
  - *The publish door with a stored row.* A stored extension that already carries the word is refused at its next publish or restore, since nothing cancels the written item's own finding. That is how an `object` write with a stored offending field already behaves, and the changeset says so.
  - *Relabel the platform's `sys_member.role` to a compliant label.* `fieldPatches: { role: { label: … } }` is judged on the label alone (the field name sits only in `where` and `path`), so the relabel ADR-0090 D3 itself asks for stays open.
  - *A doubled finding.* The owner loop and the extension walk read disjoint declarations; the side-by-side case pins one finding each.

Findings:

- **nit — the hint is wrong for a re-declared platform field.** An extension that re-declares an existing `sys_*` field whose name is the platform's own (`fields: { role: … }` on `sys_member` or `sys_invitation`) is refused with "Rename using 'position' …", a remedy the author does not have: the name is the owner's. The refusal itself is defensible (D3's exception covers the third-party schema, and the display change has its own slot, `fieldPatches`, which passes), so correctness and the contract are unaffected; only the prescription misses in this corner. Leave as an accepted deviation or a follow-up card; a code fix here moves the head.
- **nit — `content/docs/data-modeling/object-extensions.mdx`, "Naming the fields you add", does not mention the freeze.** It is the page an extension author reads for field-name rules and it now omits one that refuses at build and publish. No sentence on it became false. A follow-up docs card, not this head.
- **nit — the rule docblock still opens "across SIX collections" and then appends the extension walk as a "plus"**, while the runtime-surface test now tables six stack keys including `objectExtensions`; and `authoring-rules.ts` still says "All six collections … the other four are one collection each" above a six-type list. Comment arithmetic only. Accepted deviation.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：保留词 role 的检查（`security-role-word`）现在也检查对象扩展（`objectExtensions`）写到对象上的内容：扩展新增字段的名字和标签、扩展的 `label`、`fieldPatches` 里的字段改标签；`os validate` / `build` / `verify` 和 Studio 发布 `object_extension` 的入口都会拒绝，消息与对象自身声明时一字不差，位置指向作者写的扩展条目。
- 为什么改：QA 场景里作者在对象字段上被拒后，把同一个 `role` 字段挪进对象扩展，结果 validate、build、verify 全过，应用带着 `role` 字段启动；同一个词一个入口拒、另一个入口放，正是 ADR-0090 D3 规则文档禁止的形状。
- 风险与回滚：只收紧拒绝面；对象自身的判断不变（对照用例钉住）。给 `sys_*` 对象加字段的扩展也会被判（系统对象豁免只覆盖平台自己的声明）。首方包里的三个扩展（showcase、plugin-auth、downstream-contract）都不含该词。已存的扩展照常读取，只有下次发布会被拒。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts` 的 `validateSecurityRoleWord` 末段扩展走查（约 1735-1775 行）；`packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.ts` 新增的 `object_extension` 行；`packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` 该规则的 `runtimeTypes`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-security-posture.test.ts -t 31998`，预期 8 例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

席位意见：fable 契约复审一轮 PASS（6756744109），无必改、无建议改，三条 nit 不改动代码。运行时发布门同步拦截是席位裁决（认领修订 2），否则 CLI 拒、Studio 发布放，正是本卡要消除的同一种分裂。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · domain:spec#3 · head `dcc2177de15988c0d264c74939cea0488295e719`

- **Shape:** 8 files (+346 −20) on merge-base `c9246279`: `validateSecurityRoleWord` walks `objectExtensionsByTarget` (fields by name and label, the entry `label`, each `fieldPatches.F.label`) through a shared `flagRoleLabel`; `VisibleObjectExtension` carries `label` and `fieldPatches` (no change to which entries survive); `object_extension` gains a `TYPE_TO_STACK_KEY` row and joins the rule's `runtimeTypes`; pins in both test files; `@objectstack/lint` minor changeset; one docs paragraph.
- **Premise measured:** at `c9246279` the rule read `recordsOf(stack.objects)` only, and the `object_extension` publish ran no lint rule (claim 6754956777, dev report 6756642483).
- **Gates:** check-runs on this head: 58 success, 10 skipped, 0 red, `mergeable_state` clean. Dev report: lint 8391/8391 + typecheck 0, metadata-protocol 22641, runtime 9290, cli unit 5847, full dogfood 445 files / 3689 tests green, 96 derived gates exit 0 with `--ran` 0 NOT-MEASURED, ablation 8/224 red, real door probe `main` published → head `422 security-role-word`.
- **Contract review:** 6756744109 on this head, `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, narrowing face: PASS, no must-fix, no should-fix.
- **Declarations:** `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, `@objectstack/lint` minor with the BREAKING banner, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`; `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-adr-0087-registration` exit 0 with this body (bare `no` control exits 1). `Skills-docs: none` is true: `security-role-word` / `reserved word` have no hit under `skills/`. Changeset and docs sentences checked against the diff: the Before/Now/System objects/Not judged bullets and the new `validating-metadata.mdx` paragraph each match a pinned case.
- **Accepted deviations:** `packages/lint/src/object-graph.ts` outside the first file surface (claim amendment 3); the refusal hint says "Rename" where an extension re-declaring a platform field could only relabel through `fieldPatches` (nit); two code comments still count "six collections" / "the other four" (nit).
- **Out of scope:** the runtime gate runs only this rule on `object_extension` writes — dropped: no shape measured that another CLI rule refuses on an extension while the door admits it, so no reach; top-level `actions` (reviewer observation) — dropped: `defineStack` merges object-bound top-level actions into the object's `actions` (`stack.zod.ts` L891-892), which the owner loop already judges; `object-extensions.mdx` not naming the vocabulary freeze — dropped: nothing on it became false.
- **Landing:** not governed (`check-governed-merges --pr 32034`: 366 lines, 0 governed paths), Tier S. 14 first-parent commits behind `main`, no overlap with the diff. The landing stroke (`label-write.mjs --issue 32034 --comment-file … --land`, i.e. `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`) was refused by this session's auto-mode classifier ("Merge Without Review") at 2026-11-10T02:16Z; per `landing-operations.md` the seat stops and reports to the maintainer rather than re-spelling it. The PR stays draft, ACCEPTed and green.

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`

Delta record. The head moved from `dcc2177de15988c0d264c74939cea0488295e719` (PASS record 6756744109) by one commit, a merge of `origin/main` `0f7389cc` into the branch. This record judges only whether what `main` brought in interacts with what the PR changes; everything record 6756744109 judged on the PR's own lines is carried, not re-derived.

Inputs read: card #31998 body and all 6 comments (triage 6754733467, claim 6754956777, amendments 6755007508 / 6755042440 / 6756008506, dev report 6756642483); PR #32034 body, its 8-file list, the net diff `0f7389cc...6fcbd688`, records 6756744109 and 6757058308; `git log --first-parent dcc2177d..6fcbd688` (one commit, parents `dcc2177d` and `0f7389cc`); the main-side diff `c9246279..0f7389cc` (38 first-parent commits) on every PR file and for every symbol the PR's diff names; the check-runs on `6fcbd688`.

### ① Derived judgments

Check-runs on `6fcbd688` at this read: 45 runs, 14 success, 9 skipped, 22 in progress, 0 failed. Concluded green: Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Spec property liveness, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Check Documentation Links, Dogfood Regression Gate, Check PR Size, Flag docs affected, Auto Label, filter, both shard planners. ⛔ Not concluded: Test Core 1-8/8 (the family that runs the two pinned test files on the merged tree), Build Core, Build Docs, Build UI Deps, Type Check · workspace / source gates / consumer gates / debt ledger, Lint · ESLint, Lint · repo and tooling gates, Lint · CI, release and engine gates, Lint · docs and code guards, Lint · scoped · slot lookup and corpus / query-options erasure, Live E2E UI. Nothing was run locally to stand in for them. The judgments below are read off the tree; a red conclusion on a pending family on this head is not covered by this verdict.

What the merge is, measured:

1. **No PR-authored line moved.** `git diff c9246279 dcc2177d` and `git diff 0f7389cc 6fcbd688` are identical once `index` and hunk-header lines are dropped. The merge has no combined diff (no conflict hunk, no hand resolution).
